Here's the ranking of Nirvana's studio albums by sales:

| Rank | Album | Release Year | Estimated Sales |
|------|-------|--------------|-----------------|
| 1 | Nevermind | 1991 | ~22+ million |
| 2 | **In Utero** | **1993** | ~9-12 million |
| 3 | Bleach | 1989 | ~5-6 million |

While Nevermind remains their biggest commercial success, In Utero performed remarkably well considering it was conceived as an intentionally less commercial follow-up to Nevermind. The album was critically acclaimed and won a Grammy Award for Best Alternative Music Performance in 1994.

Streaming is made up of two families – audio and video. Our CSPC methodology now includes both to better reflect the real popularity of each track.
